scope: Filesystem PNG inspection and renderer/data consistency checks; no browser or computer UI.
findings: All 101 coefficient indices were reconstructed from the four finite factor-lane exponent lists and matched the accepted input table.
The figure contains 30 contributing factor-pair dots, 25 distinct odd composite exponents, and 24 zero-coefficient odd-prime markers.
The examples correctly show 97:0, 99:2, and 81:2, with 81's square pair counted once.
Labels, formula, axes, legend, sidebar and footer are readable without observed clipping or overlap.
Domain guards explicitly exclude zero, one and even numbers from the odd zero-count primality implication.
Colors denote smaller-factor contributions and are explicitly distinguished from zeta phase quadrants.
The caption does not claim a speed advantage or an RH result.
SVG trailing path-data whitespace was normalized before hashing; PNG and SVG delivery copies are byte-identical to repository figures.
limitations: This is visualization verification, not a separate proof of the arithmetic theorem.
The SVG was generated by the same Matplotlib figure and is available for export; native browser rendering was not inspected.
